title: Evaluating Automated Testing on an Open-Source Web Application Using Cypress
abstract: arXiv:2608.19960v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: End-to-end automated testing is increasingly used in web software development to ensure system quality and shorten response times during development. However, the true effectiveness of automated testing depends on many factors including execution time, stability of test results, and maintainability of the test suite as the application continues to evolve. In this paper, we evaluate the effectiveness of end-to-end automated testing using the Cypress framework for an open-source web application. We deployed the experiment with 27 test cases. The test's effectiveness is measured by execution speed, reliability, and maintainability. The experimental results show that the Cypress-based end-to-end test suite has short and stable execution times. It suits frequent runs during software development. translated_title: 评估使用Cypress对开源Web应用进行自动化测试的有效性
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.19960v1 公告类型：新 摘要：端到端自动化测试在Web软件开发中日益广泛使用，以确保系统质量并缩短开发过程中的响应时间。然而，自动化测试的真正有效性取决于许多因素，包括执行时间、测试结果的稳定性以及随着应用程序不断演进时测试套件的可维护性。在本文中，我们评估了使用Cypress框架对开源Web应用进行端到端自动化测试的有效性。我们部署了包含27个测试用例的实验。测试的有效性通过执行速度、可靠性和可维护性来衡量。实验结果表明，基于Cypress的端到端测试套件具有短且稳定的执行时间，适合在软件开发过程中频繁运行。大多数测试用例在多次运行中结果一致，而仅有涉及复杂交互的少数测试出现偶发性失败。
tldr: 本文通过实验评估了Cypress框架在开源Web应用中的端到端自动化测试，发现其执行时间短且稳定，适合频繁运行，但复杂交互测试存在偶发性失败。
en_tdlr: This paper evaluates Cypress-based end-to-end automated testing on an open-source web application, finding short and stable execution times suitable for frequent runs, with flakiness only in complex interaction tests.
